mapper.sql: SELECT inventory_balance.*, ROUND(purchaseAveragePrice * balanceQuantity, 2) AS inventoryAmount FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(material_code), '')), MAX(NULLIF(material_id, ''))) AS groupKey, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(material_id, '')), MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(material_code), ''))) AS uuid, MAX(NULLIF(material_id, '')) AS materialId, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(material_code), '')) AS materialCode, MAX(material_name) AS materialName, MAX(model) AS model, MAX(brand) AS brand, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' AND category NOT IN ('WAREHOUSE_TRANSFER_TO_PROJECT', 'PROJECT_TRANSFER_TO_WAREHOUSE') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 4) AS inboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'OUT' AND category NOT IN ('WAREHOUSE_TRANSFER_TO_PROJECT', 'PROJECT_TRANSFER_TO_WAREHOUSE') THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 4) AS outboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity WHEN txn_type = 'OUT' THEN -quantity ELSE 0 END), 4) AS balanceQuantity, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' AND category IN ('PROJECT_PURCHASE', 'CENTRALIZED_PURCHASE') AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN unit_price * quantity ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' AND category IN ('PROJECT_PURCHASE', 'CENTRALIZED_PURCHASE') AND unit_price IS NOT NULL THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0), 0 ) AS purchaseAveragePrice, MAX(txn_time) AS lastTxnTime FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(material_code), ''), material_id) ) inventory_balance
